sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Doping - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Now you're a full-fledged warrior, which means the expectations are higher. You want to stay at the top of your game? Use doping! I mean what did you expect? Grab the syringes and get into the fight. Time won't wait!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of a painkiller

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill 30 enemies in any game mode while having the effect applied.
